comment: The drive is one plus 25 times the knob (Nap.cpp:123, :30). The solver is a forward Euler step on (in - out)/22 less 0.504 times sinh(out/45.3) (Nap.cpp:175), scaled by the DISTORT knob (Nap.cpp:170). The result is divided by 10, hard clipped to ±1 and multiplied by 5 (Nap.cpp:146 to :158). The algorithm is credited in a comment to Alex Jilkin. The maker's parameter names are Snore amount and Dream amount where the panel prints DRIVE and DISTORT, which the entry notes.
